cmd:
# Download and install Gitea (single binary, ~60MB)
echo 'Downloading Gitea...'
sudo curl -fsSL 'https://dl.gitea.com/gitea/1.24.0/gitea-1.24.0-linux-amd64' -o /usr/local/bin/gitea
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/gitea
echo 'Downloaded'
gitea --version

# Create required directories
sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/gitea
sudo mkdir -p /var/log/gitea
sudo mkdir -p /etc/gitea
sudo chown -R vitalij:vitalij /var/lib/gitea /var/log/gitea /etc/gitea

echo 'GITEA_READY'
